##### SECTION M7 (-F on an incremental whose receiver is ahead (U1/U2), rollback -r vs local user properties (U4), modified head (U5), full stream onto a copy with snapshots (U6))  tag=C  zfs-2.2.2-0ubuntu9.5
#note: U1: sender zfsbcapc/M7/u1src has old,new1,new2. Each receiver t_* is built with a full stream of @old and an incremental to @new1 (its history is AHEAD of the base @old). Then: zfs send -i @old @new2 | zfs receive [-F] -s -u
=== CASE M7/U1.00_sender_snaps
--- cmd
zfs list -H -t snapshot -o name,guid,createtxg -r zfsbcapc/M7/u1src
--- rc
0
--- stdout

zfsbcapc/M7/u1src@new2	10944563859685899340	15
--- stderr
=== END
